For most products (pillows, sheets, bedding, etc.):
Go to our Return Portal
Enter your order number and email address
Select the item(s) you want to return and follow the prompts
You'll receive a prepaid UPS label via email
Ship your item(s) back within 10 days of printing the label

Have your order details ready
Provide photos of the item in its current condition and all law tags (front and back)
Confirm the address where the item is currently located
You can submit this information by emailing support@avocadomattress.com with your order number in the subject line, or through the support chat.
